## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAreaChartElement> CreateAreaChartElement( const std::string &id, int x, int y, int width, int height);   // Area Chart Factory
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasAreaChartElement(const std::string &id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `BarChartOrientation`

Which way the bars run. Vertical: categories along the bottom, values up the left. Horizontal: one row per category, its name on the left, values along the bottom - the form for "power by device" or any list of named amounts whose names are longer than a bar is wide.
